fusions.name: Torn-Up Turf
fusions.desc: You rip a chunk of ground loose and hurl it for 7 damage, hitting harder the further it flies, up to 1.8 times at 6.5 tiles. You hold 3; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Knuckle Drum
fusions.desc: You pound the ground with both fists, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Territorial Display
fusions.desc: You beat your chest and plant yourself: up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 4 seconds, and the damage you take falls by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rubble Troop
fusions.desc: A bonded ape of rough stone fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it hits moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
